children.title: Integrating Autonomous Multi-Agent Frameworks and Curiosity-Driven Exploration for Open-Ended Discovery

detail.title: Integrating Autonomous Multi-Agent Frameworks and Curiosity-Driven Exploration for Open-Ended Discovery
detail.summary: Autonomous problem formulation benefits from multi-agent collaboration and intrinsic curiosity. However, systemic limitations—such as non-convex scalarization in objective learning—constrain the ability of these systems to independently prioritize diverse, non-trivial research problems.
detail.reason: Revising to integrate the constraint of non-convex scalarization identified in the objective discovery research.
